content: {"episode_id":"ep-05090","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Given concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms and potential stroke risk, long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was ordered to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances. This appeal requests review of that documented clinical indication; the payer letter identifies coordination of benefits verification as the reason for the CO-22 denial."}
